verdict.rationale: Shopify's theme store offers professionally designed, fully flexible themes ('Look for a design with features you need most, then customize from there'; 'Fully flexible and regularly updated') plus AI-assisted design and prebuilt themes ('Design fast with AI. Pick a prebuilt theme. Or go totally custom.'), which directly supports no-code storefront launch and customization of layout, sections, and branding. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reviews specifically praising theme customization UX (community evidence is mostly about pricing/API/support gripes rather than theme editor quality), and no detail on the actual section/block editor mechanics.
